title: Soft Phone Apps: Browser Extension and Windows App | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A phone that lives inside a web page loses its call when you reload or leave the page, and cannot ring when the page is closed. The CrestApps soft phone apps, a browser extension and a Windows app, open your site's phone in a window of its own and keep a background connection that rings for incoming calls. This video shows the administrator steps on the site, and describes how to set up each app.

In this video:
• Why phone apps, and where each one runs
• The administrator's steps: the feature, the permission and the site domain
• The soft phone page that the apps open
• Setting up the browser extension
• Setting up the Windows app
• The kill switch, managed installs and use cases
